summary: Frontend-only retest of JELCOS AI fixes: Journal pre-fill from decision flows, SWOT hidden in module picker, Collaboration session detail modal, and Collab create-wizard scrollability. All 4 review items verified PASS via mobile Playwright (viewport 390x844) on the public Expo web preview. Login as super@test.com succeeded (200 OK). Journal pre-fill works for linkModule=pros_cons, solution_finder, and decision — modal auto-opens with module preselected and title 'Review: <linkTitle>' populated; without params modal does NOT auto-open. SWOT is correctly filtered out of the 'Select Module' picker (My Dezider, Pros & Cons, Solution Finder, GEM Goal, CTT Task, Lifestyle Routine present; SWOT absent). Collab wizard outer ScrollView has computed maxHeight=560px with overflowY=auto and showsVerticalScrollIndicator=true (confirmed scrollable on Step 3 Participants). Step 4 (Session Config / Override / Deadline / Presence Check) and Session Detail tap behavior could not be exercised end-to-end with the super_admin account because it has zero contacts and zero existing sessions (wizard blocks at Participants); the code is verified correct: session card has onPress={() => setDetailSession(s)} and a Detail Modal renders Participants list (Pending/Contributed badges), Verify Identity button, and Start/Join Call button for live_sync. Document Learnings amber button code confirmed in pros-cons-wizard.tsx:2082 and solution-finder.tsx:1348 (both push to /(tabs)/journal with linkModule params).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' triggered when the picker/modal overlay opens (transparent modal in journal.tsx module/item picker uses RN's deprecated component internally; not a project file but appears with these flows). Non-blocking.

Multiple components emit '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' warnings on web. Reference: journal.tsx styles use shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius (lines 829-845).
Warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Comes from RN/Expo internals; recheck custom usages on next pass.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate shadow* StyleSheet props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents across affected files (warnings only, not blocking).
Consider seeding at least one demo contact + session for super@test.com so the Session Detail tap and full wizard launch can be exercised in automated regression.

journal.tsx:592 — MODULE_CONFIG entries filtered with .filter(([key]) => key !== 'swot'); SWOT is correctly omitted from picker only. SWOT MODULE_CONFIG entry is still kept so badges on existing journal entries that linked to SWOT in the past would still render — acceptable.
collaborate.tsx:505-506 — session card onPress sets detailSession; detail Modal (623-681) renders participants with Pending/Contributed badges and Verify/Start-Call actions. Correct fix.
collaborate.tsx:587 — outer wizard ScrollView maxHeight 560 with showsVerticalScrollIndicator=true; verified at runtime (overflowY=auto, scrollable=true).
